posts.title: Microsoft Outage 2026-11-12
posts.description: Firstly, sympathies to the sysadmins and DevOps teams managing the cloud and compute fleets during a five-alarm fire. Team members can experience white-hot stress in these situations, and it is a heroic effort to restore things to normalcy. posts.title: Git Hooks and Agent Compromise
posts.description: The security community recognized several years ago that Git hooks can represent an attack vector . Security-focused developers discourage downloading zip archives of Git repositories for this reason. A simple “git status” will kick off an executable script with the full power of a shell. posts.title: RIP Tom Skerritt
posts.description: Tom played Viper in Top Gun (1986). Tom was the lead instructor and experienced aviator educating a young class of hotshots. I don’t remember the first time I saw this movie, but I was young, possibly only 5 years old. I watched it many times and unknowingly memorized it.
